title: Blueprint books: what the game exports for a book, what it makes of books written by hand, and how many slots a book has
source: Recorded from the game by tools/game-probe/blueprint-book.mjs: LuaItemStack.export_stack and import_stack, LuaItemCommon.get_inventory(defines.inventory.item_main), active_index, label, label_color, blueprint_description and preview_icons, and LuaInventory.insert.
layout: Every `exported` is the JSON of a string the game exported. contents: what a stack holds as the runtime API says it; of a book its label, size (#inventory: the slots up to the last one that is not empty), activeIndex (LuaItemCommon.active_index) and slots (those that are not empty, each with its number); slot numbers and activeIndex count from 1 as the API does, `index` and `active_index` in the JSON from 0. entities: of a blueprint. native: books made through the runtime API. empty: a new book; emptyLabelled: with a label. beyondSize: set_stack on slot 5 of a new book. blankBlueprint: a book of a blueprint that nothing was put into and one with a combinator. book: a book the probe filled: a blueprint, a blueprint, a blueprint, a book, an upgrade planner and a deconstruction planner inserted (inserts: the slot each landed in and the size after), the second cleared (sizeAfterClear), labels, descriptions, icons and the active index set; string is what the game exported for it and exported the JSON in that. items: its items exported on their own. reimport: the game reading its own string (importResult; sameString: it exports the same again). active: active_index set to `set` (from 1), what it then reads and writes, the error where the game refused; it was 3 before each. added: two more blueprints inserted, afterAdding the book then (exportedIndexes: the `index` of every item it writes), sizeAfterClearingLast the size once the last slot is cleared. imports: per book written by hand what was sent (sent; plain: as JSON text, not deflated), the result of LuaItemStack.import_stack (0: no errors, -1: imported with errors, 1: failed), what the stack then holds and what the game exports for it. limits: inserted: blueprints inserted into a new book one by one until it took no more (filled: slots that are not empty; canInsert: whether it takes one more); imported: one book written by hand with `sent` blueprints labelled 1 to `sent`, none with an index (exported: how many items the game writes for it, lastIndex the `index` of the last). errors: what the game refused while the probe made its books.

active.error: Given active_index value (0) is too small, allowed values are from 1 to 65536
